description: Agent Recovery: submit a recovery flow: each piece of state the agent works from (a balance, task states, sent items, orders, bookings, records or something else) with the system record it is checked against, when the agent’s view is checked against it after an interruption (before new work, after new work has started, on a schedule or never) and what happens when they differ (the system record wins, the agent’s view wins, work stops for a person or the difference is only logged), and whether new work waits for reconciliation to finish, plus optionally the recoveries seen with when reconciliation finished, when new work started and the differences found and settled. The signed report says whether the agent’s view is reconciled against the system’s record before new work starts, and names every view never checked, checked only after new work or trusted over the record, no hold on new work and every recovery seen starting work before reconciliation (the agent resuming on its own stale picture), then every check only on a schedule, every difference only logged and every difference left unsettled, with the fix for each. This reads agreement on state after an interruption: expected settlements against received transfers are wever_settlement-reconciliation-check, cached context that can outlive a change is wever_cache-staleness-check and what an interrupted task’s reported state shows is wever_partial-state-check. Verdict resumes_on_stale_state, reconciliation_gaps, reconciliation_unverified or reconciled_before_work. POST /api/state-reconciliation-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-recovery-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-recovery/.

flow.description: The recovery flow, such as resume after a crash.

gate.description: New work waits until reconciliation finishes.

items.description: Each piece of state the agent works from.

checked_against.description: The system record it is checked against, such as the chain or the order service.

kind.description: What it is: a balance, task states, sent items, orders, bookings, records, or something else.

name.description: What the agent keeps a view of, such as the wallet balance.

on_mismatch.description: What happens when they differ: the system record wins, the agent’s view wins, work stops for a person, or the difference is only logged.

when.description: When the agent’s view is checked against that record after an interruption: before new work, after new work has started, on a schedule, or never.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

runs.description: Recoveries seen, with when reconciliation finished and new work started.

differences_resolved.description: Every difference was settled before work went on.
